reproduction.rationale: The reproduction outcome retains matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions for the original V1 neural-only Conv+Trans task, with EEG and MEG scored separately. The exact original sentence-cluster splits, person/session/keystroke identities, complete unpadded output support and source ablation-control correspondence are not authenticated. The author export subject regex and supplied EEG person grouping remain unreconciled. Authentic common observations, protected test-label exposure, source-native per-keystroke and sentence-output verification, author-code delivery closure and equal cumulative budgets are not frozen. Only official author code may be the information addition; metadata binding, generated bridge controls, printed paper aggregates or an author replay do not establish paired AI execution or either scientific outcome.
